result.reason: The redline improves Section 13.1 by covering Affiliates and contractors, limiting revocation, and permitting successor transfers. However, Section 13.3 still permits revocation of “a licence” for certain breaches, which appears to include the paid-up licences that must be irrevocable under Section 13.2. Section 13.3 should be limited to subscription licences. In addition, Section 13.2 permits contractors only to “support” paid-up material, rather than extending the licence generally to contractors acting on Customer’s behalf. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated intent, but the remaining internal inconsistency prevents the clause from reaching the preferred position.
